title: A Peculiar Invitation
description:
Some items appear ordinary until you learn what they are willing to do for you. Enigmatic artifacts reward curiosity, but not every mystery asks for a sacrifice.

This is an introductory reading entry ONLY. It does not claim the dimension was entered, a boss was defeated, a relic was equipped, or any reward has been earned. Runtime-verified item/structure objectives will be authored later.

Field note: This path is separate from the Seven Curses route. You do not need to equip the cursed ring.
